label: Letters and sounds
desc: Words that show each letter value: d, đ, gi, r, x, tr, nh, ng, ph, th, kh, and the vowels ă â ê ô ơ ư

label: Tone pairs
desc: Same letters, different tone, different word: ma, má, mà; bàn, bán, bạn

label: Greetings and courtesy
desc: Hello, goodbye, thank you and sorry, said with the right kinship word

label: Family and kinship
desc: Family members, and the same words used for "you" and "I"

label: Numbers and money
desc: Numbers to 100 and up, and prices in đồng and nghìn

label: Classifiers and things
desc: Everyday things and animals with their classifier, and this and that

label: Food and drink
desc: Phở, bánh mì, coffee, and ordering at a street stall or café

label: Shopping and the market
desc: Do you have…?, colors, haggling and paying

label: Time, days and dates
desc: Clock time, days, months, yesterday and tomorrow, and đã, đang, sẽ

label: Around town and directions
desc: Places in town, where things are, left, right and straight on

label: Travel and transport
desc: Motorbike taxis, ride-hailing, buses, trains, tickets and hotels

label: Work and study
desc: Jobs, school, skills and what you can do

label: Health and help
desc: Feeling sick, the pharmacy, and asking for help

label: About me
desc: Name, nationality, age, job, and where you live

label: Describing things
desc: Adjectives for people, places and things, and comparing them

label: Questions and connectors
desc: Question words, yes/no questions, and the words that join sentences

label: Traps for English speakers
desc: False friends, calques, and là where English says "is"

label: Polite Vietnamese
desc: ạ, dạ, vâng, nhé, xin, mời: the small words that make you sound polite

label: Compliments
desc: Praise food, work, homes and effort, and answer modestly the Vietnamese way

label: Flirting
desc: Pretty, handsome, charming: the words, the phrases built on them, and kind ways to say yes or no (anh / em forms)

label: Top nouns
desc: The most-used nouns, bare as in a dictionary; to count one, add a classifier (Top classifiers)

label: Top verbs
desc: The most-used verbs; Vietnamese verbs never change form

label: Top adjectives
desc: The most-used describing words, which work like verbs: no là

label: Top adverbs
desc: Time markers, degree and frequency: đã, đang, sẽ, cũng, rất, lắm, vẫn

label: Top pronouns
desc: The kinship address system (anh, chị, em, bác, ông, mình…), with who says it to whom

label: Top prepositions
desc: của, cho, trong, với, ở, từ, trên and the other place, time and means words

label: Top conjunctions
desc: và, để, khi, thì, vì, nên, nếu: the words that join ideas

label: Top interjections
desc: What people really exclaim: Ôi!, Trời ơi!, Thôi chết!, Hú hồn!

label: Top words
desc: Question words, determiners, yes and no, numbers 11 to 20, days and times

label: Top classifiers
desc: The counter words that go between a number and a noun: con, cái, chiếc, quả, bát…

label: Top particles
desc: The little words at the end of a sentence: ạ, nhé, nhỉ, à, chứ, đấy, cơ
